items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: Charlie Colin, Charles Colin used to publish those, and those were a rarity.

ctx.x: You were doing like second year jazz education. I mean that is such great ear training to discover that on your own.

Yeah it is. Because again, I mean they had these books like hot jazz solos that were written out, you know, make believe solos by somebody and Charlie Colin, Charles Colin used to publish those, and those were a rarity. I mean we’d get our hands on those it’d be nice. But they really didn’t give you, they were pretty diatonic. They didn’t give you the real deal. You know you hear Miles Davis play on some of these tunes, even on a blues, you know what was that all about? You know your ears think wow, it works but…
Yes. And if I play the same thing is it going to work as well as that.
